dimensions.description: Observes canonical private dependency reach and rejects Skill Mechanics as a direct user-goal route.

evals.name: canonical-consumer-invocation
evals.prompt:
/skill-mechanics

Represent the already-decided contract supplied by Skill Writing.
evals.expected_output: The named private dependency can be loaded by its consumer using the canonical name.
expectations: The host records Skill Mechanics activation by its exact canonical name.

evals.name: private-user-goal-false-activation
evals.prompt: Help me decide whether our recurring deployment task should become a new Skill.
evals.expected_output: Skill Mechanics stays inactive because it is not advertised as a user goal and does not decide whether a Skill should exist.
expectations: The host does not record a direct Skill Mechanics selection or load.
